question: Which article of the Indian constitution is related with the special provision with respect to the States of Maharashtra and Gujarat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 371 of the Indian Constitution** provides certain special provisions for** Maharashtra and Gujarat.**
 
• It includes the establishment of separate development boards for** Vidarbha, Marathwada, Saurashtra, and Kutch.**
 
• **The President of India** is **responsible for ensuring the equitable allocation of funds for developmental work in these regions.**
 
• These provisions also assure adequate representation of these regions in service under the State.
